tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Linen ground of the sheet that rises over the photo.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text on paper. Warm olive-brown, never black.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and stat cells.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sage. Body-asking marks, script accents, chart fills.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Clay. Other pulls in charts. Never a warning colour.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Every word on the photo, and the main button's fill.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Optional. Per-line band behind words on the photo, for very busy photos only. Default is no highlight.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Strength of the left-to-right darkening over the photo behind the text column.

title.usage: The app or page name, once, on the photo.

numbers.usage: The hero number and stat figures. Lining, tabular.

reading.usage: Sentences on the photo, names, insights.

ui.usage: Small UI text and captions on paper.

button.usage: The main action, in serif caps.
